text: The Gemini API key has run out of prepaid credits, so the website chat, AI Accountant and AI Analytics are unavailable until billing is topped up in Google AI Studio.
Some reporting views could be read without logging in. Closed by a permissions-only migration.
Five helper functions with no caller check were callable by anyone, including one that posts notifications into staff inboxes. Closed.
10 of 12 edge functions existed only in the Supabase dashboard. All 12 are now in git with their settings pinned.
The login form stayed on screen above the module after a normal login.
Saving an employee removed any role that has no checkbox on the form.
Opening a CRM page in a new tab signs a user without Remember me out on every tab and device.
The public chat endpoint has no server-side rate limit and its origin check can be faked, so the AI quota can be drained.
Contact details typed into the chat are not stored, though the assistant says the team will follow up.
Two AI functions are deployed but unused; one accepts unauthenticated conversation starts and can create CRM enquiries.
Financial Settings linked from 7 pages and the menu did not exist. The module is now built on existing tables.
The Supabase library was loaded unpinned, so every upstream release went live untested. Pinned to 2.119.0.
Pressing Enter in the password field counted toward the 5-attempt lockout.
One failed session check was cached, ejecting genuine staff.
Double-clicking Save created duplicate payments, invoices, quotations, orders and more.
Editing a record with an inactive linked service, provider or order blanked that link on save.
Allowance edit or remove could hit the wrong row.
Confirm could run the same action twice.
Phone fields kept the previous record's country and rewrote local numbers.
Searchable dropdowns could show the previous record's value.
Some totals and rankings add different currencies together.
An idle second tab signs the user out everywhere.
Staff see menu links to owner-only pages that then sign them out.
Stockists and Email pages skip the shared sign-in safeguards.
A failed sync can leave a gap in stored metrics; Search Console results stop at 5,000 rows.
Eight database functions lack a fixed search path.
Leaked-password protection is switched off.
Duplicate document-number counters (pay / PAY) can produce the same payment number.
Backend source and internal docs were published on the website.
Conversations showed every staff member as Staff.
Overhead allocation mode was saved double-encoded.
Form Builder owner-only fields were shown to all staff.
Email page loaded twice and the first Cc remove button did nothing.
Bank-detail errors showed Saved; some search text broke the provider filter.
Renewal dates overflowed at month end (Jan 31 + 1 month became Mar 3).
RM Dashboard Open links did not go to the order; notification links could run script.
View did nothing on iPhone Safari; report and certificate views crashed on hidden joins.
404 page unstyled on nested URLs; non-www canonicals; broken excerpts on Insights and Case Studies.
Entries made between midnight and 5 am Pakistan time are dated the previous day.
Campaign tracking overwrites the landing page on every view.
Two function headers and the analytics setup guide describe settings the code no longer uses.
